focus: Houston inside and just outside the Loop (Downtown, Midtown, Montrose, Upper Kirby, Rice Village, West University, Medical Center, Uptown/Galleria, Westchase, Memorial City, Spring Branch, Oak Forest), plus Clear Lake and Northeast Houston
intro: This first Houston page covers private mailbox stores inside the city of Houston whose own public pages list an address, staffed hours, and package acceptance — three independent pack-and-ship stores in West University and west and southwest Houston, plus fifteen UPS Store locations from Downtown to Clear Lake, all open on Sundays. It is not a complete metro inventory; Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, and other suburbs are not covered yet. 24-hour lobby access is flagged only when the store’s own page says so. The UPS Store pages mention 24-hour access only at participating locations, so that flag is off for those stores. Box availability can change; treat it as something to confirm. If you cannot get to a storefront, compare virtual mailbox services.

listings.name: West U Boxes Pack N Ship

hours.notes: Staffed store hours for the week of November 20, 2026, as shown on the mailbox rental page. The same page says mailbox customers have 24-hour access to a brightly lit, secure mailbox area.

listings.carriersNotes: The mailbox rental page says the store accepts packages and mail from the Post Office, UPS, FedEx, DHL, and couriers.
listings.visitNotes: The mailbox rental page says mailbox customers have 24-hour access to a brightly lit, secure mailbox area. It does not say whether packages too large for a box can be picked up after staffed hours. Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.
